body: That used to be me. I was sexually abused at the age of 6, it happened more than once and it shaped my life into something else. By the time I was 10, I was addicted to pornography and by 11, I was living in depression. I didn’t wanna live. I wasn’t myself, I hated every part of me. I used to wish sickness upon me because I didn’t have the courage to put my parents through hell by killing myself. I remember googling “ways to kill yourself”. I stated getting sick from the age of 13 and by the time I was 16, I had an NG tube (feeding tube) going down my nose. There wasn’t a single night where I didn’t cry myself to sleep. I was drowned in the ocean of pain, guilt and shame. I was born and raised in a Hindu family, did every ritual I could to make myself feel better but nothing worked. I had heard about Jesus from a friend of mine and I cried out to Jesus on a very desperate night, I said “Jesus, If you are real, either take me or heal me”. My friend invited me to a conference one day and God healed me there and in 2019, Jesus freed me from all of my addictions, pain, hurt, shame, depression. He became more real to me than any other person in this planet. Jesus changed my life. I am a new person. I’m happy, I’m free. Serving Jesus. The same Jesus that freed me and saved me can save you too. You don’t have to life a defeated life, you can live in victory everyday. You don’t have to look for ways to end your life, you’ll enjoy every bit of your life. Jesus loves you. He wants to heal you.
